key.name: recent-projects
key.description: JSON encoded list of recently opened project folders.

key.name: active-label-position
key.description: Position of the active project folder name relative to the panel icon. Values: 'left' or 'right'.

key.name: panel-position
key.description: Which area of the panel the extension sits in. Values: 'left', 'center', or 'right'.

key.name: panel-order
key.description: Order within the panel area. Negative moves left, positive moves right. 0 is the default position before system indicators.
